learning-methods.hint: To identify the method, ask where its learning signal comes from: supplied answers, hidden structure in raw data, labels created from the data itself, or rewards from interaction.

learning-methods-01.label: Learns from examples containing inputs paired with known labels or numeric targets.
learning-methods-01.why: Learns from examples containing inputs paired with known labels or numeric targets.

learning-methods-02.label: Finds structure in unlabeled data, such as groups, associations, or unusual patterns.
learning-methods-02.why: Finds structure in unlabeled data, such as groups, associations, or unusual patterns.

learning-methods-03.label: Creates supervisory signals from the data itself, such as predicting masked or missing content.
learning-methods-03.why: Creates supervisory signals from the data itself, such as predicting masked or missing content.

learning-methods-04.label: Learns a policy by taking actions and receiving rewards or penalties from an environment.
learning-methods-04.why: Learns a policy by taking actions and receiving rewards or penalties from an environment.

learning-methods-05.label: Aligns model behavior using human preference comparisons that train a reward signal.
learning-methods-05.why: Aligns model behavior using human preference comparisons that train a reward signal.

learning-methods-06.label: A supervised task that predicts a category or class.
learning-methods-06.why: A supervised task that predicts a category or class.

learning-methods-07.label: A supervised task that predicts a continuous numeric value.
learning-methods-07.why: A supervised task that predicts a continuous numeric value.

learning-methods-08.label: An unsupervised task that groups similar records without predefined labels.
learning-methods-08.why: An unsupervised task that groups similar records without predefined labels.
